value.body: A three-year science degree that applies biology to products and processes. You study cell and molecular biology, genetics, biochemistry, microbiology, immunology, genetic engineering and bioprocess techniques, with a lot of lab work. It is offered as a single major or as one subject in a combination, and leads to lab and quality work in biopharma, diagnostics and research, and often to an M.Sc.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4 years for Honours / Honours with Research under the UGC four-year UG framework (NEP 2020)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in the science stream, usually with Physics, Chemistry and Biology; some colleges also accept Mathematics in place of Biology. Central universities admit through CUET-UG scores; many state universities and their colleges admit on Class 12 merit or a state test, and private universities may run their own tests. This is a separate route from NEET-based medical admissions.

value.title: At a glance
items: R&D and scientist roles usually expect an M.Sc or PhD; with a B.Sc, entry roles are mostly lab, production, QC support, clinical research or sales.
GAT-B, IIT JAM (Biotechnology) and CUET-PG lead to many M.Sc seats.
This is a different degree from the four-year B.Tech in Biotechnology.
Teaching needs a B.Ed for schools, or a master's plus NET/SET or PhD for colleges.
